model.name: scenarioView.typeDispatch
model.description: /scenario?ior=<uuid> resolves the unit's actual type from /api/trace/children response (type field), NOT from the graph (which only has 7 trace types). viewRegistry registers handlers for ALL types (Room, User, Device, File, Message, Skill + the 7 trace types + Sprint). Falls back to rb-detail-view for unknown types.
